title: List the average lap time in seconds for all French drivers who participate
question: List the average lap time in seconds for all French drivers who participated in races held in Spain, considering only those laps that were faster (i.e., had fewer milliseconds) than the fastest lap recorded in the 2009 Spanish Grand Prix.

INNER JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T1."XCL_068" = T4."XCL_001"
